title: FAQ
intro: Common questions about taking part in the Connected Minds study.

items.a: See the Eligibility section on the homepage — in short, Malaysian, 60 or older, no severe head injury or neurological diagnosis, normal or corrected vision and hearing, and no neurologically active medication. Your partner needs to meet the same criteria.

items.q: Do I have to join with a partner?
items.a: Yes — social interaction is a core part of the study, so sign-up is as a pair.

items.q: Can you assign a partner for me?
items.a: We're not able to — you'll need to bring someone you already know, such as a friend, relative, or spouse, who also meets the eligibility criteria.
